other_failure_modes.name: string_conversion_of_numerical_features
other_failure_modes.description: Converting numerical features to strings and then applying LabelEncoder sorts the values lexicographically rather than numerically (e.g., '10.0' comes before '2.0'). This severely destroys the ordinal relationship and predictive power of continuous features for tree-based models.

summary: The agent successfully establishes an end-to-end pipeline with model comparison and ensembling, but introduces a critical data corruption issue by converting all features to strings before label encoding, destroying the numerical order of continuous variables. Additionally, it peeks at the test data by fitting the LabelEncoder on the combined dataset and uses a naive ensembling strategy.
